Feat ci (#4)

* ci(labelab): add Android release CI + signing config

- .github/workflows/trigger-branch.yml: on push branches → pre-release (canary)
- .github/workflows/trigger-tag.yml: on push v* tags → full release
- .github/workflows/build-android.yml: reusable workflow_call target
  - setup-java@v4 (temurin 17) + subosito/flutter-action@v2
  - decode ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret → labelab-release.jks
  - write key.properties for gradle signing
  - build APK (always) + AAB (tag only)
  - pre-release: ncipollo/release-action@v1 with allowUpdates (canary tag)
  - release: softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with APK + AAB
- .github/dyn-workflows/build-android.yml: psdk-style reference copy
- android/app/build.gradle.kts: signing config via key.properties / env vars

Secrets to configure in GitHub:
  ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64, ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS,
  ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD, ANDROID_STORE_PASSWORD

* ci(labelab): restructure to psdk/endfather dyn-workflows pattern

- dyn-workflows/staging.yml: on push branches → build APK → canary pre-release
- dyn-workflows/production.yml: on push tags v* → build APK + AAB → release
- workflows/trigger-branch.yml: minimal, delegates to kangumi/dyn-actions
- workflows/trigger-tag.yml: minimal, delegates to kangumi/dyn-actions
- removed workflows/build-android.yml (workflow_call approach replaced)

* Update workflows to use double quotes and add ensure-main job to staging

The ensure-main job checks for 'main' in branch.txt and gates
build-android.
This improves workflow control for staging builds.

* ci(labelab): parallel APK + AAB build via matrix in production

* ci(labelab): apply matrix pattern to staging for consistency

* Update workflow secrets and YAML quoting for Android builds
